title: Peruvian Tuna Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy Peruvian-inspired bowl dish featuring seared tuna and a variety of vibrant ingredients.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the tuna steaks with salt and pepper.
3. Sear the tuna for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
4. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
5. Add the sliced red onion and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until softened.
6. Stir in the cooked lima beans, Peruvian corn kernels, and chopped cilantro.
7. Squeeze the lime juice over the top and stir to combine.
8. To assemble the bowls, place a cooked tuna steak on top of the bean mixture.
9. Drizzle the Suspiro sauce over the top and serve immediately.
